headline: Full-Stack TypeScript Developer
summary: Full-stack TypeScript developer with about three years of commercial work. I take products from an empty repo to real users: React, Next.js and TanStack on the front, Node or Bun with PostgreSQL and Drizzle on the back, CI/CD and observability around it. Built an ed-tech platform solo that British teachers use today, built and deployed sportmagaz.com.ua (a store with its own admin panel) on my own, and shipped wallet, bonus and identity services for a live iGaming platform. Claude Code daily, everything reviewed.
